name: Hinokakera -the fragments of innocent sinner-
source:
Set in the post-apocalyptic future, after the humanity had suffered an attack from a group of inhuman creatures and was nearly wiped out, with the technical progress coming to a permanent halt, it revolves around a group of characters, each with their own mission. While some of them are humans, others posses demonic powers, which had caused several Demon Sealing Wars in a not-so-distant-past. Particularly, "fragment:Eclipse" offers a visual novel like Story mode that follows the adventures of a single character - Raven.

-From Mobygames
translation:
故事发生在后世界末日的未来，人类遭受了一群非人生物的攻击，几乎被消灭，技术进步也永久停滞，故事围绕着一群角色展开，每个角色都有自己的使命。其中一些是人类，另一些则拥有恶魔之力，这在不久的过去曾引发过几场封魔战争。特别是，《碎片：月食》提供了一种类似故事模式的视觉小说，讲述单个角色——瑞文的冒险。

- 来自Mobygames
